transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this meeting because we have 1,200 cast aluminum housings on hold with cosmetic residue from the forming operation. Before I can authorize any rework and release the campaign plan, we need to go through our standard pre-authorization review with process engineering, maintenance, quality, and EHS. I'd like to hear from each of you on what we're dealing with and whether the ultrasonic cleaning cell is ready to handle this. Let's start with process engineering -- what caused the residue, and what rework process are you recommending?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share the results of my process trial. I completed a trial yesterday and found that the residue can be successfully removed from only 900 of the 1,200 housings using our ultrasonic cleaning process. The remaining 300 housings have embedded residue that cannot be removed and must remain on hold. I have not yet entered this result in the production release system, so I wanted to bring it to everyone's attention now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something about the ultrasonic cleaning cell. During my weekly walkdown, I inspected the cell and found that the circulation-pump seal must be replaced before we can use it. That's a planned 4-hour downtime. I haven't opened the maintenance work order yet, but we need to account for that before any rework campaign starts.

transcript.text: I need to share something important from the customer side. I checked the customer control plan this morning and received a revised plan from the customer portal. It requires that every reworked housing must receive dimensional scanning, and exactly 30 reworked housings must be retained for customer review. I have not yet updated our local inspection instruction to reflect these requirements, so we need to factor that into our rework campaign planning.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share the results of my waste review for this campaign. I've confirmed with our site's waste contractor this week that the spent cleaning solution from this campaign must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes and shipped under a waste manifest. I have not yet updated the area waste-board notice, so we need to make sure that gets done before the campaign starts and that we have the totes and manifest ready.
